title: Diabetic Retinopathy AI
description: End-to-end clinical AI screening retinal fundus images and grading severity in <2s with Grad-CAM explainability, React 19 UI, ONNX-optimized FastAPI, and clinical PDF reports.

title: JeevaLink (iTantra)
description: 100% offline, zero-cloud emergency mesh transceiver for SIH 2026. Transcribes Indic voice to ~0.4 KB packets hopped over Wi-Fi Direct/BLE mesh with 360° Haversine radar triage.

title: DeviceGuardian AI
description: PHM/telemetry system predicting device hardware failure (remaining useful life) using XGBoost. 1st place at a hackathon.

title: MedRemind & Diet AI
description: Cross-platform healthcare web and mobile app enabling precise medication scheduling, automated dietary/food synergy suggestions for recovery, and real-time drug interaction checks.
